changes_made.explanation: Added 'Speech-to-Speech Translation' as a more specific task since this is the primary focus of the paper. Normalized 'HiFi-GAN vocoder' to 'HiFi-GAN'.
Confirmed BLEU is the only automatic metric used. Normalized to standard capitalization.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper.
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper. The paper only mentions ASR-based evaluation and BLEU scoring.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on speech-to-speech translation using diffusion models. The extraction was mostly accurate. The paper evaluates using BLEU scores computed on ASR-transcribed outputs rather than direct human evaluation. No LLM-based evaluation was used. The main contribution is applying diffusion models to textless speech translation while preserving semantic structure.
